@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: That simple, long dress shows off her s______r figure.
= slender
~詞義 slender（adj.）苗條的
~原文 That simple, long dress shows off her slender figure.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: There are so many books in the b______e that it seems to be sagging under the weight.
= bookcase
~詞義 bookcase（n.）書架
~原文 There are so many books in the bookcase that it seems to be sagging under the weight.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: I always keep a f______t in my backpack when I go camping because it can get really dark outdoors at night.
= flashlight
~詞義 flashlight（n.）手電筒
~原文 I always keep a flashlight in my backpack when I go camping because it can get really dark outdoors at night.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: My mother is a very experienced and s______l driver. For example, she can park a car in the smallest of spaces.
= skillful
~詞義 skillful（adj.）熟練的
~原文 My mother is a very experienced and skillful driver. For example, she can park a car in the smallest of spaces.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The apple was so j______y that liquid burst out from it when I bit into it.
= juicy
~詞義 juicy（adj.）多汁的
~原文 The apple was so juicy that liquid burst out from it when I bit into it.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The team came up against a ______ wall after their project was rejected three times, despite carefully rewriting it each round.
A: jazz
B: brick
C: silk
D: hum
= B
~詞義 brick（n.）遇到瓶頸(come up against a brick wall)
~原文 The team came up against a brick wall after their project was rejected three times, despite carefully rewriting it each round.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: A flash of ______ lit up the night sky, and a few seconds later, we heard the sound of thunder.
A: koala
B: lightning
C: bowling
D: cotton
= B
~詞義 lightning（n.）閃電
~原文 A flash of lightning lit up the night sky, and a few seconds later, we heard the sound of thunder.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: You should heat the ______ to 200 degrees before putting the pie inside.
A: oven
B: cotton
C: leopard
D: squirrel
= A
~詞義 oven（n.）烤箱
~原文 You should heat the oven to 200 degrees before putting the pie inside.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: "Do you think Ted will arrive on time?" "I wouldn't ______ on it, since he's late to almost every meeting we've ever had."
A: bind
B: hum
C: sink
D: bet
= D
~詞義 bet（v.）不太可能(wouldn't bet on it)
~原文 "Do you think Ted will arrive on time?" "I wouldn't bet on it, since he's late to almost every meeting we've ever had."

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Oscar loves ______ music and often goes to live concerts to see his favorite bands play.
A: loaf
B: brick
C: shrimp
D: jazz
= D
~詞義 jazz（n.）爵士樂
~原文 Oscar loves jazz music and often goes to live concerts to see his favorite bands play.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: bowling
B: bloody
C: spinach
D: steal
E: overseas
F: sink

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Ellen's son hates ______. However, it is a very healthy vegetable, so Ellen still makes him eat it.
= C
~詞義 spinach（n.）菠菜
~原文 Ellen's son hates spinach. However, it is a very healthy vegetable, so Ellen still makes him eat it.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The backpack was an absolute ______ because it cost half the usual price and still looked brand-new.
= D
~詞義 steal（n.）極便宜的東西
~原文 The backpack was an absolute steal because it cost half the usual price and still looked brand-new.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Someone hit William in the face, and he got a(n) ______ nose.
= B
~詞義 bloody（adj.）流血的
~原文 Someone hit William in the face, and he got a(n) bloody nose.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: My father goes ______ with his friends every weekend. It's his favorite indoor leisure activity.
= A
~詞義 bowling（n.）保齡球
~原文 My father goes bowling with his friends every weekend. It's his favorite indoor leisure activity.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Michael was a(n) ______ student at Cambridge, and he didn't go back to his country after he graduated.
= E
~詞義 overseas（adj.）來自海外的
~原文 Michael was a(n) overseas student at Cambridge, and he didn't go back to his country after he graduated.

@bank
A: kindergarten

D: lemonade
E: loaf
F: bet

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: To Ginny, graduation felt ______ because she was excited for new opportunities but sad to leave her closest friends behind.
= B
~詞義 bittersweet（adj.）苦樂參半的
~原文 To Ginny, graduation felt bittersweet because she was excited for new opportunities but sad to leave her closest friends behind.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The little boy is going to his first day of ______ tomorrow.
= A
~詞義 kindergarten（n.）幼稚園
~原文 The little boy is going to his first day of kindergarten tomorrow.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: I ______ that the home team will win the basketball game.
= F
~詞義 bet（v.）打賭
~原文 I bet that the home team will win the basketball game.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Our class will sell iced ______ in the school fair.
= D
~詞義 lemonade（n.）檸檬水
~原文 Our class will sell iced lemonade in the school fair.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The cook took a ______ of brown bread and cut it into five pieces.
= E
~詞義 loaf（n.）一條(麵包)
~原文 The cook took a loaf of brown bread and cut it into five pieces.
